title: Tonnelle nord-ouest au Parc de Marquayrol (La Pergola)

said.q: Painted in 1925, Tonnelle nord-ouest au Parc de Marquayrol (La Pergola) takes the viewer behind the walls of Martin’s garden, revealing its pièce de résistance: a stately yet romantic pergola strewn with flowering foliage. A towel lies beneath the luxuriant umbrella of blooms and Martin paints a still-life tableau of a water pitcher, glass and bowl of fruit amidst the dense thickets of plants, juxtaposing peaceful accoutrements of domestic life with the powerful beauty of untamed nature.

events.n: depicts the artist's garden at Marquayrol; the text also gives "Circa 1925"
